steps: The Planer performs a Planing operation on a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt for 57 minutes, achieving a Planing depth of 0.5 mm, a Feed rate of 0.2 m/min, and a Surface finish of Ra 0.8, producing a Planed part that is then placed back onto the ConveyorBelt.

The Stewart Platform Mills perform Milling to transform a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground part, using an End mill with ±0.01 mm precision and active vibration damping, for 44 minutes.

The Grinding operation uses Grinding Machines for 17 minutes to transform a Planed part from the ConveyorBelt into a Ground part on the ConveyorBelt, utilizing an Aluminum oxide grinding wheel at 1800 rpm with a feed rate of 0.05 m/min.

Using a CNC Turning Center, the lathed part is precisely machined into a finished machined component through CNC Turning with a custom G-code program, utilizing Tool 1, 2, and 3, at a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, for 94 minutes.

The Honing Machine performs honing for 67 minutes using a 400 grit size and a 5-minute cycle time to process a honed cylinder with a 50 mm bore size on a conveyor belt, transforming it into a precision finished part.

The Horizontal Milling Machine performs a Milling operation for 76 minutes, using a milling speed of 1000 rpm, a contour tool path, and achieving a surface finish of Ra 0.4, transforming a milled part from the conveyor belt into a finished machined component on the conveyor belt.

The Shaper machine performs a Shaping operation on a Milled part for 1 minutes, using a high-speed steel tool with a stroke length of 200 mm and a shaping speed of 20 strokes/min, transforming it into a Shaped part.

Using a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine, the shearing operation cuts sheet metal into sheared sheet metal at a shear angle of 1.5° and a cutting speed of 0.8 m/min with a high carbon steel blade, lasting for 84 minutes.

Using a Punch Press, the punching operation processes sheet metal taken from a conveyor belt into a finished sheet metal product, employing a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 40 strokes/min, and manual die alignment, for 31 minutes.

The milling operation, performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 78 minutes using an end mill at 1200 rpm and a depth of cut of 2 mm, transforms a lathed part from the conveyor belt into a milled part, which is then placed back onto the conveyor belt.

Using a Horizontal Lathe, the Turning operation shapes a Metal bar into a Lathed part for 15 minutes, with a rotation speed of 1000 rpm, a carbide insert tool, and a feed rate of 0.2 m/min.

The Gear Shaper performs the Gear Shaping operation, shaping a broached component into a 24-tooth spur gear at a speed of 30 strokes per minute for 91 minutes, with the input taken from and the output placed on a conveyor belt.
Using a Gear Shaper machine for 56 minutes, shape a broached Gear Blank into a 24-tooth spur gear at a shaping speed of 120 RPM, transferring the resulting ShapedGear to a Mobile Robot.
